Stable SDL3-CS feature and Android compatibility release for SDL 3.4.14.

This release updates the managed wrapper and every platform-specific core package to the exact SDL 3.4.14 stable source. Android packages are rebuilt with native 16 KB page-size support. The production release rebuilds and validates the complete native RID matrix from the exact manifest source revisions so every supported platform remains version-aligned.

## Package Versions

| Package family | Version |
|----------------|---------|
| `SDL3-CS` | `3.4.14.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>` | `3.4.14.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Image` | `3.4.4.9` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Mixer` | `3.2.4.8` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.TTF` | `3.2.2.8` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Shadercross` | `3.0.0.8` |

## Changes

- Updated the core SDL baseline from 3.4.12 to the exact stable SDL 3.4.14 release, including matching wrapper documentation and native packages ([#246](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/246)).
- Added a managed SDL main-callback application contract and opt-in generated entry point, including managed-state lifetime handling and exception containment ([#232](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/232)).
- Rebuilt the complete Android native payload with Android NDK r28c and explicit flexible page-size support ([#244](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/244)).
- Rebuilt the Android SDLActivity bridge from the exact SDL 3.4.14 source revision and retained deterministic source/version parity gates.
- Added fail-closed checks for every packaged Android shared library, final APK alignment, Android App Bundle page alignment, and execution on a 16 KB Android environment.

The SDL 3.4.14 header describes GIP metadata reset as enabled by default. The exact 3.4.14 release runtime still uses `false` when that hint is unset; applications that require reset behavior should set the hint explicitly.

Applications targeting Android 15/API 35 or newer should update the managed package and every Android native component package to the versions shown above.
